visual.description: The dominant light warm-grey background used across most page sections.
Near-black dark brown used for primary headings and large display text.
Same near-black used for body copy and descriptive text throughout.
Deep near-black background used for dark sections including pricing and footer areas.
Slightly lighter dark surface used for card and panel backgrounds in dark contexts.
Vivid lime-green used as the primary CTA button color and announcement ticker background.
Bold violet-purple used as an accent color on membership cards and secondary CTA buttons.
Off-white used for text, labels, and icons within the dark navigation bar.
Very dark near-black pill-shaped navigation bar background in the top-of-page state.
Same dark background retained in the scrolled/sticky nav state — no color change on scroll.
Off-white text and icon color retained in scrolled nav state.
Lime-green Join button inside the nav bar, consistent across both scroll states.
Subtle dark border/divider used on input fields, cards, and separator lines in dark surfaces.
Slightly off-white surface used for lighter card backgrounds on the dark pricing section.
Muted grey used for secondary labels, captions, and less-prominent text elements.
Red used for the handwritten annotation arrows (e.g. 'See what it can do!' callout arrow).
